coverImageAlt: Ava stands at Haven’s Vanguard’s open loading hatch above a snowy settlement
summary: A glimpse of green life in the frozen world awakens everything Ava has lost. With another refuge ahead, she and Gabriel confront memories neither can carry alone.
seoTitle: Shadows of the Past | Ava: Sporelight
metaDescription: On the road to a frozen refuge, Ava’s lost world and Gabriel’s grief surface as their cautious bond becomes more personal.
